title: Warqi Puri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Maida (All-purpose flour) sifted 2 & ½ Cups
steps.romanUrdu: -Maida (All-purpose flour) sifted 2 & ½ Cups

steps.instruction: -Sooji (Semolina) ¼ Cup
steps.romanUrdu: -Sooji (Semolina) ¼ Cup

steps.instruction: -Zeera (Cumin seeds) 1 & ½ tsp
steps.romanUrdu: -Zeera (Cumin seeds) 1 & ½ tsp

steps.instruction: -Kali mirch (Black pepper) crushed ½ tsp
steps.romanUrdu: -Kali mirch (Black pepper) crushed ½ tsp

steps.instruction: -Ajwain (Carom seeds) ½ tsp
steps.romanUrdu: -Ajwain (Carom seeds) ½ tsp

steps.instruction: -Red chilli (Red chilli) crushed ½ tsp
steps.romanUrdu: -Red chilli (Red chilli) crushed ½ tsp

steps.instruction: -Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -Ghee (Clarified butter) melted 3 tbs
steps.romanUrdu: -Ghee (Clarified butter) melted 3 tbs

steps.instruction: -Water 1 Cup or as required
steps.romanUrdu: -Water 1 Cup or as required

steps.instruction: -Maida (All-purpose flour) 1 & ½ tbs
steps.romanUrdu: -Maida (All-purpose flour) 1 & ½ tbs

steps.instruction: -Ghee (Clarified butter) 2 tbs
steps.romanUrdu: -Ghee (Clarified butter) 2 tbs

steps.instruction: -Cooking oil for frying
steps.romanUrdu: -Cooking oil for frying

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add all-purpose flour,semolina,cumin seeds,black pepper crushed,carom seeds,red chilli crushed,salt & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein maida,namak,sooji,zeera,kali mirch crushed,ajwain,lal mirch crushed aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: -Add melted clarified butter& mix well until it crumbles.
steps.romanUrdu: -Melted ghee dal dein aur crumble ho janay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Gradually add water,mix well & knead until dough is formed,cover & let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 15 minutes kliya rest dein.

steps.instruction: -Knead dough until smooth & divide into 7 equal portions.
steps.romanUrdu: -Dough ko smooth hunay tak dubara ghond lein aur 7 equal portions mein divide ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Take one small dough (80g),make a ball,sprinkle dry flour & roll out with the help of a rolling pin (8 inches).
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek portion (80g) lein aur ball bana lein,maida chirak dein aur rolling pin ki madad sa (8 inches) bail lein.

steps.instruction: -Repeat the same process for all portions & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Yehe same process tamam portions kliya karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add all-purpose flour,clarified butter & whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein maida aur desi ghee dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: -On 1st rolled dough,apply flour & ghee mixture and place another rolled dough on it.
steps.romanUrdu: -1st rolled dough per flour & ghee mixture laga lein aur us ka upper dosri rolled dough rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -Now place remaining rolled dough in similar manner (6 layers) and apply flour & ghee mixture in between each layer.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ab is he tarhan tamam rolled dough raktay jayein aur flour & ghee mixture her layer ka bech mein lagatay rahein (6 layers).

steps.instruction: -Gently roll the dough into a log shape,cut thin portion with a sharp knife avoid to damage the layering of dough.
steps.romanUrdu: -Gently roll ker ka log shape bana lein aur sharp knife ki madad sa thin portions mein cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Take one portion of dough,press gently & roll out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek portion lein,gently press karein aur rolling pin ki madad sa pheela lein.

steps.instruction: -In a wok,heat cooking oil & fry on low flame until golden & crispy (makes 11-12).
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein cooking oil garam karein aur halki ancch per golden & crispy ho janay tak fry ker lein (makes 11-12).
